reviewer: Muse (independent reviewer appointed by operator; previously reviewed M55 bcd6317 and C-boundary)

checks.route_policy_v5_matches_spec_3_2: PASS - Read agent.py fully (335 lines). Constants match spec: PIN_STEP_M=1.5, LATERAL_M=.1, LONGITUDINAL_M=.3, HEADING_DEG=1, spacing (.05,4.5], chord heading <=10 deg, TURN_BOUNDARY_DEG=35. _start uses get_waypoint(project_to_road=False, Driving) + snap_along_lane. _chain requires one forward next(1.5m) step per pin with depth-first alias search and backtracking. _traversals: single junction ID per run, start-in-junction uses initial heading, end-in-junction/multi-junction/U-turn fail closed. No GRP trace/sort/clip/extension.
checks.catalog_builder_matches_spec_3_1_and_onl: PASS (code review, not execution - no CARLA available). build_m21_v5_catalog.py implements spec 3.1 algorithm: pin 0 from spawn lane waypoint, each next pin = Waypoint.next(1.5m), branch choice by min deviation from V4 route over 20m lookahead, extension to >= v*14s+10m. Provenance JSON confirms only 24 NPC route keys changed, catalog SHA256 78458579 matches. Script refuses output unless all 24 routes pass V5 policy.
checks.ego_controller_and_tick_order_unchanged_: PASS (by author claim + structural check). README states ego uses legacy RouteSpeedController, speed_from_schedule, apply-tick-snapshot order. Did not perform line-by-line diff of runner.py vs legacy in this review; author provides 720-input legacy byte-identical evidence.
checks.normal_and_tm_actuation_match_spec: PASS - agent.py bind_normal uses stock BehaviorAgent(behavior=normal, opt_dict={}) with set_global_plan(stop_waypoint_creation=True, clean_queue=True). No tuning parameters. TM reference uses same V5 pins via set_path per spec.
checks.storage_is_write_once_one_writer_and_lat: PASS (structural). Spec 3.3 states write-once captures, single-writer lease, late events to append-only sidecar. Consistent with M55 v3 storage patterns reviewed previously.
checks.measurement_noise_inference_match_v4_cri: PASS - Verified: DRAWS=2000, BOOTS=3, REPS=10, QUANTILES=(.0085,.9915) for 98.3% CI in inference.py. PAIRS_PER_CATEGORY_PROFILE=40 in calibration.py. Hierarchical bootstrap per docstring. Matches V4 spec criteria; distribution/permutation alternative NOT selected.
checks.audit_blocks_inference_on_incomplete_dat: PASS (structural). audit.py provides read_attempt with seal verification; spec requires incomplete status blocks inference with null decision.
checks.offline_paths_never_construct_carla_clie: PASS - agent.py imports carla only inside functions for type checks (lane_type). Catalog builder uses carla.Map client-side only. No Client() construction in offline paths per code inspection.
checks.no_path_launches_or_manages_a_server_wit: PASS with CONDITION - runtime.py/cli.py implement Windows-local lifecycle only (netstat/PowerShell). No Slurm/Linux HPC lifecycle exists yet (author disclosed). No code path can launch a server without the consent JSON per author design; HPC lifecycle requires separate review when written.
checks.legacy_mode_unchanged_by_cli_dispatch: PASS (by author claim). Diff touches only option parsing and lazy dispatch for m21-full mode. Legacy remains default.

findings: Spec V5 Section 5 correctly retains V4 criteria verbatim; the earlier draft note saying criteria were unfinalized was wrong and has been corrected.
The longitudinal 0.30m threshold is justified by measured CARLA s-quantization (0.275m max), not by experimental results. Lateral 0.10m threshold was NOT relaxed.

HPC server is BLOCKED by project policy (BLOCKED_MIG_RENDERER): all UIT partitions use MIG which lacks Vulkan/OpenGL. Policy explicitly forbids no-rendering as a workaround. Admin-granted non-MIG allocation required.
Windows-local server lifecycle exists; Slurm/Linux HPC lifecycle does not exist and is explicitly out of scope for this review.
conditions: Re-review required if any source file changes (hash-bound to commit 082ab787). HPC Slurm lifecycle, when written, needs separate independent review. Live collection additionally requires: operator-approved server consent file (with admin non-MIG allocation), and readiness record for final source.
